gen-dafont-edo-sz-gf-abeezee: Approachable is the word for ABeeZee, its terminals stopping short of the stem. Edo SZ earns its keep big and short, where its lowercase carries the stature of cast iron capitals in one constant stroke.
gen-dafont-edo-sz-gf-aldrich: Iron-cast swagger up top: Edo SZ draws a lowercase with capital stature in a single constant stroke width. Down a full column, Aldrich's cupped rounds keep moving without clenching.
gen-dafont-edo-sz-gf-alexandria: Alexandria reads tall in the body, with short stems above and below. Above it, Edo SZ lays down a marker-nib line that ignores direction, so heading and text feel cut from different tools.
gen-dafont-edo-sz-gf-amiko: Amiko's terminals flare outward like a pair of tongs. Edo SZ excels at round bowls whose walls never thicken or thin, while Amiko works as a plain sans with crayon-thick lowercase strokes.
gen-dafont-edo-sz-gf-anek-bangla: Cultural in feel, Edo SZ draws each downstroke without calligraphic swell, its lowercase standing like cast iron capitals. Anek Bangla sits beneath as a plain sans, its wide s curves and short midline-to-ascender reach giving the heading room.
gen-dafont-edo-sz-gf-anek-devanagari: Anek Devanagari gives its sans-serif text distinctly open letter mouths and a tall middle zone. Edo SZ is best at a tube-like thickness through every bend, while the body font is best at carrying text.
gen-dafont-edo-sz-gf-anek-gujarati: Anek Gujarati has lowercase that rivals its capitals, while Edo SZ looks sketched in pencil that never presses harder. Its gaping c keeps a full column of text moving along.
gen-dafont-edo-sz-gf-anek-gurmukhi: Anek Gurmukhi hands its sans-serif text big open counters. Edo SZ is best at cast iron stature in one steady thickness, while Anek Gurmukhi is best at open-handed curves in every round letter.
gen-dafont-edo-sz-gf-anek-kannada: Edo SZ gives its lowercase the stature of cast iron capitals, all on a monoweight skeleton. Anek Kannada's high woodblock x-height and far-flung terminals take on sans-serif text duties.
gen-dafont-edo-sz-gf-anek-malayalam: Anek Malayalam keeps almost no gap between lowercase and capitals, while Edo SZ bends cord-like curves as stout as its stems. Anek Malayalam leaves its curve tips untouched, so a full page of text breathes.
